name: margin-note-annotations
title: Margin Note Annotations
description: Body text with superscript markers that open notes in the outer margin on wide viewports and inline expanders on narrow ones — a responsive recomposition of the scholarly annotation, not just a hidden block.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Editorial
Macrostructure: Asymmetric
Density: Medium
Shape: Sharp
Motion: None
Typography: Humanist
Color: Monochrome

## Rules

- Click Expand Note: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
